title: An Elephant's Trunk Inhales Air at 330 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: An elephant sniffs air in at 330 miles per hour.
That's more than 30 times faster than a human sneeze.
It lets the trunk pull in about three liters of water in one second.
Yet the same trunk can pick up a single chip without breaking it.
The trick: the nostrils widen inside, stretching the trunk's volume by about 64 percent.
A vacuum cleaner and a fingertip in one nose. 330 miles an hour, and still gentle.

first_comment: Which is more impressive, the speed or the gentleness?
